text:
Start: 1455-12-25  
Add 11 weeks = 77 days.  
Add 6 days = total 83 days.  

1455-12-25 + 83 days:  
December has 31 days → from Dec 25 to Dec 31 = 6 days (remaining 77 days).  
January 1456 has 31 days → 77 - 31 = 46 days left.  
February 1456 is a leap year? 1456 divisible by 4 (Gregorian not yet adopted but proleptic Gregorian says yes) → 29 days → 46 - 29 = 17 days left.  
March 1456: add 17 days → 1456-03-17.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1456-03-17
